name: Dip buyer: $NPG
description: Places nothing ahead of time: it only buys $NPG listings when the price is at or below a set level, like a standing limit order. At most $2 a buy, $6 a day, $50 in total. Edit buyBelowUsd to your own level before loading. It can lose money: token prices can fall and listings can be thin. A price that has dipped can keep falling.
goals: Watch $NPG. Buy only when a listing is at or below the buy limit. Prefer the cheapest listing. If nothing is cheap enough, do nothing.

spec.trades: $NPG only (BSV-21), at or below $0.50 a token
spec.often: Only when a listing is at or under the limit
spec.needs: Agent account with at least $10 of BSV
